name: MeepleAI English Golden Evaluation Dataset
description: English golden evaluation dataset for the 5 golden games (Catan, Wingspan, Dominion, Ark Nova, 7 Wonders). Unions real source_page ground truth from the seed/mozilla/custom datasets into page-level expected_citations (#3467). relevant_chunk_ids are intentionally empty pending the #3427 re-index (recall labeling via the labeling-assist workflow).

samples.question: What are the five resource types in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: The five resource types are brick, lumber, wool, grain, and ore.

samples.question: How many victory points are needed to win a game of Catan?
samples.expected_answer: A player needs 10 victory points to win the game.

samples.question: How many bird cards does each player start with in Wingspan?
samples.expected_answer: Each player starts with a hand of 5 bird cards, of which they may keep any number by discarding food tokens to pay for them.

samples.question: What are the three habitat rows on the player mat in Wingspan?
samples.expected_answer: The three habitat rows are Forest, Grassland, and Wetland, each associated with a different action when a bird is played there.

samples.question: How many action phases occur during a round in Dominion?
samples.expected_answer: A player's turn has three phases: Action, Buy, and Cleanup. The Action phase allows playing one Action card unless additional actions are gained.

samples.question: How many Copper, Silver, and Gold cards are in the supply for a 2-player game of Dominion?
samples.expected_answer: In a 2-player game the supply contains 46 Copper, 40 Silver, and 30 Gold cards.

samples.question: How does a player end their turn in Dominion, and what happens to unused cards?
samples.expected_answer: At Cleanup, the player discards their hand and all cards played this turn, then draws a new hand of 5 cards from their deck, reshuffling their discard pile if needed.

samples.question: What are the four action types available on the player's turn wheel in Ark Nova?
samples.expected_answer: The four action types are Build, Animals, Cards, and Association (X-tokens), each represented by a card the player plays face-up onto their action wheel.

samples.question: How does a player increase their reputation in Ark Nova?
samples.expected_answer: Reputation increases primarily by playing animals that satisfy their placement requirements and by fulfilling conservation project requirements; each action also advances the appeal and conservation tracks separately.

samples.question: How many ages are played in a game of 7 Wonders, and how many cards does each player draft per age?
samples.expected_answer: A game of 7 Wonders is played over 3 ages. In each age, every player is dealt a hand of 7 cards and drafts one card at a time by passing the remaining hand to a neighbor.

samples.question: In which direction do players pass cards during Age II of 7 Wonders?
samples.expected_answer: During Age II, cards are passed counter-clockwise (to the right), reversing the clockwise direction used in Age I.

samples.question: How is military conflict resolved at the end of each age in 7 Wonders?
samples.expected_answer: At the end of each age, each player compares their military strength (shield symbols) to both neighbors; the player with more shields wins a conflict token worth increasing victory points per age (1, 3, or 5), while the loser gets a -1 point defeat token.

samples.question: How many settlement pieces does each player start with in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: Each player starts with 5 settlement pieces.

samples.question: What resource cards are needed to build a road in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: One brick and one lumber are needed to build a road.

samples.question: When a 7 is rolled in Catan, what happens to players with more than 7 resource cards?
samples.expected_answer: Players with more than 7 resource cards must discard half of their resource cards (rounded down).

samples.question: How many victory points are needed to win a standard game of Catan?
samples.expected_answer: 10 victory points are needed to win.

samples.question: What is the longest road bonus in Catan and how many victory points is it worth?
samples.expected_answer: The Longest Road card is awarded to the first player to build a continuous road of at least 5 segments. It is worth 2 victory points.

samples.question: In 7 Wonders, how many cards does each player receive in the first age?
samples.expected_answer: Each player receives 7 cards at the beginning of each age.

samples.question: How does card drafting work in 7 Wonders?
samples.expected_answer: Each player selects one card from their hand, plays it simultaneously, then passes the remaining cards to the next player. Direction alternates by age.

samples.question: Can you trade with the bank in Catan, and at what ratio?
samples.expected_answer: Yes, you can trade 4 identical resource cards for 1 resource card of any type with the bank. With a harbor, the ratio can be 3:1 (general) or 2:1 (specific resource).

samples.question: How many development cards can you buy per turn in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: You can buy as many development cards as you can afford per turn, but you can only play one development card per turn.

samples.question: How many resource cards does each terrain hex produce when its number is rolled?
samples.expected_answer: Each terrain hex produces 1 resource card for every settlement adjacent to it, and 2 resource cards for every city adjacent to it.

samples.question: What resources are needed to build a city in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: 3 ore and 2 grain are needed to upgrade a settlement to a city.

samples.question: What is the placement rule for settlements in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: Settlements must be placed on an unoccupied intersection that is at least two intersections away from any other settlement or city (the distance rule).

samples.question: How do ports work in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: Ports allow better trade ratios with the bank. A general port allows 3:1 trades, while specific resource ports allow 2:1 trades for that resource. You must build a settlement on a port to use it.

samples.question: What is the Knight card in Catan and how is Largest Army determined?
samples.expected_answer: The Knight card lets you move the robber to a new hex and steal a resource from an adjacent player. The player who plays the most Knight cards (minimum 3) receives the Largest Army card worth 2 victory points.

samples.question: Can you play a development card on the same turn you buy it in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: No, you cannot play a development card on the same turn you bought it. You must wait until a subsequent turn to play it.

samples.question: What happens during initial placement in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: Players take turns placing 1 settlement and 1 road in order, then in reverse order place a second settlement and road. The second settlement produces starting resources.

samples.question: What are the three main actions a player can take on their turn in Wingspan besides playing a bird?
samples.expected_answer: Gain food from the birdfeeder, lay eggs, and draw bird cards — each activated by placing an action cube in the Forest, Grassland, or Wetland row respectively.

samples.question: How many rounds are played in a game of Wingspan and how do the available turns change?
samples.expected_answer: A game lasts 4 rounds; the number of available turns decreases each round (8, 7, 6, then 5) as cubes are set aside for end-of-round goals.

samples.question: How many cards make up a player's starting deck in Dominion and what are they?
samples.expected_answer: Each player starts with a 10-card deck: 7 Copper and 3 Estates.

samples.question: What conditions end a game of Dominion?
samples.expected_answer: The game ends when the Province pile is empty or when any three Supply piles are empty; the player with the most victory points then wins.

samples.question: What are the two scoring tracks in Ark Nova and how does the game end?
samples.expected_answer: The Appeal track and the Conservation Points track; the game ends when the two markers meet or cross on the scoring display.

samples.question: What do break icons trigger in Ark Nova?
samples.expected_answer: Break icons trigger the Break phase, during which the player takes a Sponsors bonus and the card display is refreshed before play continues.
